description: Stop sending to many addresses at once — the path for importing another provider's unsubscribe list before a first campaign. Without it, everyone who already opted out there gets mailed again here. The defaults differ from add_suppression: scope 'marketing' and reason 'list_hygiene'. reason 'unsubscribe' marks a list of opt-outs, and also cancels their queued scheduled sends and ends their automation enrolments. Addresses are de-duplicated; the response counts suppressed and duplicates.

reason.description: Defaults to list_hygiene. unsubscribe also cancels queued mail and ends enrolments

name: suppress_many
